scripts.db:push: echo 'Use db:migrate instead - never push directly' && exit 1

//.postinstall: Regenerate Prisma Client after npm install
//.db:generate: Regenerate Prisma Client into src/generated/prisma (npx prisma generate)
//.db:migrate: Create + apply a migration on the dev DB: npm run db:migrate -- --name <name> (npx prisma migrate dev)
//.db:migrate:deploy: Apply pending migrations in production (npx prisma migrate deploy)
//.db:migrate:status: Check migrations are in sync - run before committing (npx prisma migrate status)
//.db:push: Blocked on purpose - never push schema directly, always use db:migrate
//.db:seed: Seed system item types via prisma/seed.ts (npx prisma db seed)
//.db:studio: Open Prisma Studio to browse data (npx prisma studio)
//.db:test: Check DB connection, migrations, seed data and a rolled-back CRUD round trip (npx tsx scripts/test-db.ts)
